meta.title: Environment & capabilities
meta.description: A page inside Settings showing what this agent can actually operate: the tool registry, skills, MCP servers and their tools, plus the CLIs you installed and the bundled DSH runtimes. Read-only and fault-tolerant; the command list scans only the directories you installed into (system directories hold a thousand-odd entries and are skipped) and executes a built-in allowlist to read versions.
